name: Spiceworks Community

sources.title: Spiceworks homepage — live IT community + news/insights; Join/Login via accounts.spiceworks.com; Vendors link to community.spiceworks.com/vendors/directory
Spiceworks Vendor Page Directory — 800+ tech brands; page is JS-rendered (Discourse)
Community post confirming the revamped Vendor Page Directory and vendor following (content read via search result)

conditions: A free community account exists and vendors historically could create/manage a Vendor Page, but vendor pages today are tightly tied to Spiceworks' commercial partnership program — the organic route is joining the community as a vendor rep ('Green Guy/Gal') and participating
requirements: Vendor participation requires identifying as a vendor rep — Spiceworks assigns 'vendor' status and brand association

Vendor Pages live in the community vendor directory; community posts say vendors can create a page via community.spiceworks.com/pages (historic flow) — full-fledged vendor pages are typically part of a paid partnership
The community audience is IT professionals — the product must be relevant to IT pros
preparation: A real IT-relevant product and a person willing to participate as the vendor rep
Company details and branding assets if pursuing a Vendor Page
Read community guidelines — overt self-promotion is discouraged; helping in threads builds the rep
workflow: Contact Spiceworks or post in the community to get vendor/brand status (historic route: community.spiceworks.com/pages to create a vendor page)
Participate in community forums answering questions (the canonical way vendors earn attention)
For full vendor-page features and campaigns, talk to Spiceworks sales — partnership is paid
watchFor: Vendor status is verified — a fake-consumer account promoting a product violates guidelines
Vendor Pages and advertising are commercial products; free organic reach is community participation only
The vendor directory page is JS-rendered and unverifiable to fetchers
Audience is IT pros — consumer SaaS is a poor fit
countsAsLive: A brand/vendor page exists in the Spiceworks Community vendor directory, or the vendor rep account is active and identified in forums
unknowns: Current self-serve flow for creating a basic vendor page (community moved to Discourse; historic /pages flow may be retired)
